body.message:
Good morning,

We would like to kindly inform you that the management has increased the rates, and the rate for your next extension will be AED 6,000.

Please note that this rate adjustment applies to all tenants currently staying in-house and is based on the updated rates set by the management.

We understand that this may be an increase from your current rate, and we appreciate your kind understanding.

Thank you for your cooperation.
